title: ID0394894-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S9 170004102] Connectors unavailable
description:

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0394894-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S9 170004102] Connectors unavailable CRM:00921001394
additional_info.body:
Please refer to the print screen. During night charging the charger disconnected (after 21:40). However the truck was connected all night. As it was 100%, the driver did not realise it in the morning.
The day after 10.12.2024 at around 15:35 the driver returned to charge. Connectors were green and changed to "preparing" and then disconnected with error. Many times. I performed a soft restart, nothing improved, but connectors became orange (unavailable).
I sended the driver to another charging station and informed our local Siemens project team, which solved the issue the day after.
Not sure whether all parameters of the charging station have been set-up correctly, as this issue happened already.
EV: Volvo E-Truck FH Electric
